name: Judge Guilty
source:
Miki is an ordinary school girl who dreams about making clearing this world of villains. She abandons the thought eventually due powerlessness.
But one day she acquires a special power and then meets friends who share her aspirations and support her.
Emptiness spreads throughout the world, and enemy has unimaginable strength. Still, together with friends she enters this battle to dissolve darkness and defeat evil.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-april-2006-tenshitsuki-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
三木是一名普通的女学生，她的梦想是清除这个世界上的坏人。由于无能为力，她最终放弃了这个想法。
但有一天，她获得了一种特殊的力量，然后遇到了与她志同道合并支持她的朋友。
虚空弥漫整个世界，敌人的力量难以想象。尽管如此，她还是与朋友们一起参加了这场消除黑暗、击败邪恶的战斗。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-april-2006-tenshitsuki-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
